content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script (commented tutorial version) for the FUNWAVE-TVD surface_wave_1d simple case. It clears the workspace (L2), sets a user-input section (L4-L17) with output directory fdir (L9) and snapshot indices files=[1 6 11 17] (L12), assumes plot time interval dt=10 (L20), builds a 1D x-axis of m=1024 points with dx=1.0 (L23-L25), loads bathymetry dep.out (L28), configures an 6x8-inch figure (L31-L33), then loops over the 4 selected snapshots (L36-L56): zero-pads the index to 5 digits (L40), loads eta_<fnum> surface elevation (L43), and plots -dep and eta versus x in stacked subplots with fixed axis [0 1024 -1.5 1.5], grid, labels, and a title showing Time = files(num)*dt sec (L46-L54).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
dep — bathymetry array loaded from dep.out (L28)
eta — surface elevation array loaded per snapshot (L43)

equations.ref: zero-padding of snapshot index to 5 digits

io.name: figure with length(files) stacked subplots of -dep and eta vs x

unresolved: fdir is a hardcoded developer-specific absolute path (L9); the script cannot run elsewhere without editing it.

dt=10 (L20) is asserted as the output/plot time interval and used in the title formula files(num)*dt (L54), but the actual model output interval is set in the case input file, not verifiable from this script.
axis x-limit 1024 (L50) exceeds max(x)=1023 given m=1024, dx=1.0 (L23-L25); off-by-one between axis range and coordinate vector.
